name: Sophie Anderson (BLOCKED - real person)
sounds_like: Female at 226 Hz with a 9.5-semitone range, mid-bright (centroid 1913 Hz), 5.3 onsets per second and very little silence (7%). Northern English, conversational and run-on - the source is podcast speech with a stumble left in and a wide 23.1 dB loudness swing.
avoid_for: All casting. For a conversational Northern or informal English female, source a reference that is not a real person.
note: BLOCKED - this is a voice clone of a real, identifiable person. This project craft notes say these must not be cast, and that holds regardless of the CC-BY 3.0 licence on the source recording: the licence covers redistributing the audio clip, not synthesising new speech in that person voice and putting words in their mouth. A card exists only so nobody rediscovers the file and casts it by accident. Do not set this to ready. Source: a July 2022 podcast appearance, via Wikimedia Commons. The subject died in 2023, which removes any possibility of consent - treat this one as permanently off-limits.
